scope: Representative independent symbolic/numerical counterchecks. Not a complete proof audit of the selected formula corpus or the cited frontier papers.

checks.name: Poisson/Gauss sign and source
checks.scope: Uniform-source analytic example in an unbounded coordinate patch; boundary data must be specified for a physical region.

checks.name: Electrostatic curl null
checks.scope: Differentiable scalar potential; not arbitrary time-dependent electromagnetic fields.

checks.name: Fixed-voltage source work changes the mechanical potential
checks.scope: Ideal quasistatic capacitor coordinate; fixed charge and fixed voltage are different controlled systems.

checks.name: Vector-potential curl and magnetic divergence
checks.scope: Uniform static B in a simply connected coordinate example; gauge representation is not unique.

checks.name: Magnetic Lorentz force does no instantaneous work
checks.scope: Magnetic q v×B term only; an induced electric field can do work.

checks.name: Newtonian exterior vacuum Laplacian
checks.scope: Identity outside the point source; the distributional delta source must not be discarded at the origin.

checks.name: Weak-field redshift expansion
checks.scope: Static Schwarzschild clock relative to infinity, weak field; coordinate time and proper time are distinct.

checks.name: Damped pole differs from forced displacement peak
checks.scope: Viscous single-degree-of-freedom displacement response; response channel and loading matter.

checks.name: Finite sampling admits indistinguishable aliases
checks.scope: Uniform ideal samples; anti-alias filtering and input-band assumptions are extra premises.

checks.name: DFT Parseval normalization
checks.scope: NumPy forward DFT has no 1/N factor, inverse has 1/N; other conventions move the normalization.

checks.name: Dispersive phase and group speeds differ
checks.scope: Ideal waveguide-like dispersion omega²=omegaCut²+c²k²; a phase speed is not a signal-front speed.

checks.name: Positive returned singular values do not imply an injective rectangular map
checks.scope: The SVD return array has min(m,n) values; inverse identifiability needs the full domain dimension.

checks.name: Uniform convergence does not justify differentiating the limit
checks.scope: A counterexample to interchanging a limit and derivative without additional hypotheses.

checks.name: An invariant spectrum does not preserve all coordinate norms
checks.scope: Similarity preserves eigenvalues, while Euclidean operator norm requires an appropriate unitary/isometric change of representation.

checks.name: Passive source/load/storage budget with independent refined quadrature

evidence.solver: SciPy solve_ivp trajectory; independent Simpson work/loss quadrature

checks.scope: Ideal driven RLC from zero state; numerical integration checks this declared model, not a built resonator or source-free energy claim.

checks.name: Representative SI dimension audit
checks.scope: Dimensions are necessary consistency checks, not sufficient evidence that a physical law or source claim is correct.
